construction.gitt25_window: the last 60 s of the rest before a 2.5 A discharge pulse, the pulse (~288 s, 0.1 s sampling) and the first 600 s of the rest after it
construction.gitt5_window: the same for the 5-pulse GITT (~1440 s pulses)
construction.hold: BACKWARD; forward hold is a sensitivity only
construction.initial_state: z from the coulomb count; v_p0 = 0 with basis: the preceding rest is >= 3000 s; screen: the voltage moves <= 1 mV over the last 60 s of that rest, otherwise excluded
construction.ocv: measured: the last sample of every rest >= 3000 s in each calibration cell's 25-pulse GITT (and of the post-charge rest at z = 1), z on Q_cal; the calibration OCV is the mean, knot by knot, over the calibration cells that reach that knot; linear between knots; never extrapolated
construction.q_basis: Q_cal = the mean, over the CALIBRATION cells, of each cell's net 25-pulse-GITT discharge to its cutoff; used for every cell in the primary evaluation
construction.rest_band_basis: the protocol has only 0 or |I| >= 0.5 A in these tests; 50 mA separates them
construction.soc: per cell, z = 1 at the end of the post-charge rest (the first discharge-pulse step's preceding rest) and z decreases by the integrated discharge over Q
construction.soc_scope: windows whose z stays in [max(0.10, lowest knot), 1]; others are excluded and counted
construction.temperature_dropouts: a Temperature sample outside [15, 40] degC in a 25 degC base-cooled test is a sensor dropout: it is excluded from the applicability check and counted; a window with any dropout inside its pulse is excluded

data.cells: LG M50T (LG GBM50T2170) 21700, base-cooled at 25 degC; 12 cells, beginning of life (RPT0, before any ageing set)
data.channels: Time (s), Voltage (V), Current (mA; negative = discharge), Charge (mA.h), Temperature (degC)
data.dataset: Kirkaldy et al. 2024, 'Lithium-ion battery degradation: comprehensive cycle ageing data and analysis for commercial 21700 cells', Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.10637534 (CC BY 4.0); J. Power Sources (2024) 234185
data.measurement_uncertainty: UNKNOWN: the record does not state the BioLogic cycler's accuracy (not read from the paper); never set to zero
data.retrieval: HTTP range requests on the five experiment archives: the zip central directory, then only the selected members, each CRC32-checked against the directory (owner-approved partial download, 2026-10-15)

frozen_before: any parameter fit and any comparison on these data

identifiability.decision: IDENTIFIABLE if R0, R1 and C1 are each identified; WEAKLY_IDENTIFIABLE if tau or R0 is but R1 or C1 is not; NOT_IDENTIFIABLE otherwise
identifiability.parameter_identified_if: profile rise >= 10 % within a factor of 3 on both sides, AND cell-block bootstrap (B = 200, seed 0, resampling calibration CELLS) CV <= 0.25, AND not on a bound, AND the hold-convention shift <= 10 %

inspected_before_freeze: the step structure (currents, durations, sampling, voltage and temperature ranges) of cell Expt 5/D's RPT0 files only, a CALIBRATION cell; no voltage was compared with any model

models.1rc: calibration OCV + R0 + R1 + C1 (engcore thevenin_route)
models.objective: sum of squared voltage residuals over every scored calibration sample
models.parameter_set_temperature_range: min and max of the valid (non-dropout) calibration temperature samples; NOT widened (no admitted sensor accuracy)

outcome_mapping.IDENTIFIABILITY_SUPPORTED: IDENTIFIABLE, no set FAILS, and a set is NOT_ASSESSABLE
outcome_mapping.MODEL_REJECTED: IDENTIFIABLE and the primary or secondary set FAILS for the 1RC
outcome_mapping.MODEL_VALIDATION_SUPPORTED: IDENTIFIABLE, and the primary and secondary sets PASS for the 1RC
outcome_mapping.ledger_rule: an outcome is a report, not a promotion. independent_validation may PASS only on MODEL_VALIDATION_SUPPORTED AND with an admitted measurement uncertainty for THIS dataset; Kirkaldy's is UNKNOWN, so the gate stays MISSING unless the owner admits one

roles.independence_unit: cell; the held-out cells are other physical cells from other experiments' rigs
roles.split_rule: by experiment number, fixed before any fit: experiments 3-5 calibrate, 1-2 are held out

acceptance.applicability: a set holding any window outside the validated domain is NOT_ASSESSABLE in both directions
acceptance.basis: the LG HG2 limits, kept; and since the LG HG2 review showed that pooling rest samples can hide a load miss, the load-only samples must meet the same limits

validation.comparison: cell-block paired bootstrap over held-out cells (B = 2000, seed 0) of RMSE_Rint - RMSE_1RC; fewer than 2 units: NOT_ASSESSABLE
validation.descriptive_only: the same held-out windows with each held-out cell's own measured OCV and own Q (parameter transfer only)
validation.primary: held-out cells' 25-pulse GITT windows, STRICT TRANSFER (calibration OCV, Q_cal, parameters)
validation.secondary: held-out cells' 5-pulse GITT windows (long constant-current pulses), strict transfer
